1 · Intro

When to use it.

Sometimes a non-exempt employee can't enter their own PTO. You can enter it for them on their time card.

Use this whenA non-exempt employee needs PTO entered and can't do it themselves.

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

Enter PTO for an employee

Use when: A non-exempt employee needs PTO entered and can't do it themselves. · System: UKG (Kronos)

  1. Open the employee's time card view.
  2. Enter the time block. Example: 4 hours, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
  3. Click Browse and choose the PTO type, such as vacation or sick.
  4. Scroll up and click Save.
  5. Exit and reopen the time card to confirm the entry saved.

Watch-outs

  • Non-exempt PTO can be entered in 4-hour increments.
  • Open period: Save only. Do not submit.
